# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Situated within Cill Cluain, this architecturally designed three-bedroom property forms part of an attractive development of just eight detached homes. This mature residential development enjoys a convenient setting just outside Louisburgh, along the main Westport–Louisburgh Road and is only a few minutes’ walk from the town.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 126.3 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: No. 6 Cill Cluain, Louisburgh
- Cena: 395 000 €
